name: Zumpo/Game intro
description: The top of a game page: what the game is and its ways in, Play solo first where the game has it, then Create a room. Open rooms are listed under it.

children.name: Name
children.text: Draw & Guess

children.name: Tagline
children.text: One draws. Everyone else tries to get there first.

children.name: Name
children.text: Minesweeper

children.name: Tagline
children.text: Clear a board on your own, or share one and pick in secret.

children.name: Name
children.text: Make 24

children.name: Tagline
children.text: Four numbers. Plus, minus, times, divide. Make 24.

children.name: Name
children.text: Pairs

children.name: Tagline
children.text: Flip two cards. Remember where everything is. Find every pair.

children.name: Name
children.text: Trios

children.name: Tagline
children.text: Spot three that are all the same or all different.

children.name: Name
children.text: Liar’s Dice

children.name: Tagline
children.text: Roll in secret. Bid on the whole table. Call the bluff.

children.name: Name
children.text: Hush

children.name: Tagline
children.text: No turns, no talking. Play every card in order, together.

children.name: Name
children.text: Daily Word

children.name: Tagline
children.text: Five letters, six guesses. A new word every day.
